License: Apache-2.0; retain LICENSE, NOTICE and original per-file copyright headers.
SHA256SUMS covers LICENSE, NOTICE and every transitive quoted include of mha.cu,
including conditionally compiled header branches. TVM/Python wrappers and
other architecture launcher translation units are not part of this subset.
No target currently links this dependency. The existing FA2 subset is separate.
Any generated initialization/single-block/symbol adaptations must be identified
in their generated source and audited against these immutable originals.
Vendoring alone is not a build, GPU correctness, or performance result.
Headerless upstream files follow the retained repository-root LICENSE:
hostUtils.h, mha_components.cuh
